knowledge.text: {"schema":"wave.spec/1","name":"wave.task/1","rev":2,"what":"One JSON envelope every Wave bot reads and returns, so any bot's answer is the next bot's input. v2 adds the Mission, role briefs, assumptions, unverified claims and routed checks.
